$notes.about: How buildings break. Rules decide what fails (web/src/core: building-structure, crush-planner, support-check); Rapier moves the pieces. Energies in joules, masses in kg, densities in kg/m³ of building volume (most of a building is air).
$notes.punchMass: kg the hero 'weighs' when smashing: impact energy = ½ · punchMass · speed²
$notes.dentSpeed: m/s into the wall below which a hit only glances (v1)
$notes.crushEnergy: J per m³ to pulverise building volume, by facade style
$notes.reserve: strength margin: a storey carries reserve × its intact load, so it fails when less than 1/reserve of its area survives
$notes.density: bulk density by facade style (glass towers are lighter)
$notes.roundToughness: crush-energy multiplier for round towers: they break as whole drums (stiff cores), so a boost hit weakens one and it takes 2–3
$notes.tunnelClearance: m added to the hero radius for the bore (small: a bore wider than a storey dilutes the hit over three floors)
$notes.pushLever: s: the punch's momentum shifts the effective load forward by Δv_above × pushLever (an overturning moment loads the far side), so a hit tower leans away from the hero
$notes.maxPushShift: cap on that shift, as a share of the segment's half-width
$notes.blowOut: cone of extra damage from the exit face inward: half-angle grows with impact speed; never deeper than maxDepthShare of the path, so the entry side survives as a hinge
$notes.strainRatio: load ratio from which a storey groans (structure:strain)
$notes.offCentreShare: centre-of-mass offset, as a share of the survivors' reach, beyond which an overloaded storey crushes its heavy side first instead of pancaking
$notes.maxCrushPasses: off-centre crush passes before the verdict is taken as is
$notes.motion: how loose pieces move (web/src/sim/destruction-system.ts). solverMassReference: kg; Rapier sees m_sim = ref·√(m/ref) so mass ratios stay solvable. spawnClearance: m shaved off new bodies so they start clear of the stump. maxPushSpeed: m/s cap on the push a hit gives a falling section. hingeTilt: rad; past this lean the hinge under a toppling section is crushed so it falls free. toppleSpin: rad/s the hit starts a toppling section turning with (the shove at its base). edgeCrushInterval: s between leading-edge failures as a leaning section rolls off its stump. edgeReserveShare: share of a storey's static reserve left against a leaning, moving section (dynamic loading), for the leading-edge test. breakupFraction: a contact carrying this share of a band's crush energy breaks a section into bands of bandStoreys storeys, and bands within chunkRadius m of the contact into storey × bay chunks. pancakeAccretion: share of a crushed storey's mass that rides down with a pancaking section (it keeps v·M/(M + share·m)). pancakeMaxStoreys: per profile. generationDecay / maxGeneration: a falling piece hitting another building damages it at this share of its impact energy, up to this many knock-ons. buildingCooldown: s between knock-ons on one building. impactEnergy: J from which a contact counts as an impact (sound, shake, dust). freezeAfter: s asleep before rubble is frozen in place. debrisLife: s, per profile. debrisBodies / chunkBodies: live-body budgets per profile. debrisPerCrushed: debris bodies per crushed chunk. friction: pieces' friction
